title: Pancake pack format
text: A Pancake knowledge pack stores vectors, corpus text, and offsets as static files. The browser loads a resident sketch tier, searches locally, fetches only the candidate byte ranges it needs, and hydrates results from corpus.bin. The pack can be hosted on any static file server that supports range requests.

title: Edge catalog hydration
text: Catalog hydration keeps search ranking separate from live product data. The search worker returns stable product identifiers from a snapshot, while the catalog service supplies current price, inventory, and URLs. Updating inventory does not require rebuilding the vector index.

title: Abstention calibration
text: Abstention calibration fits a small scorer on retrieval signals such as best distance, margin, mean top-k distance, and vocabulary coverage. A held-out title shard creates in-domain negatives, synthetic gibberish covers out-of-vocabulary failures, and optional probes let pack owners assert corpus-specific expectations.

title: Range-readable search
text: Range-readable search avoids downloading an entire vector index for every query. A compact resident tier selects likely candidates, then exact reranking reads clustered candidate rows by byte range. Clustered layout reduces scattered fetches and makes static hosting practical for repeated search sessions.

title: Worker snapshot import
text: A Worker snapshot import loads a prebuilt Pancake index into an edge runtime. Admin routes can import, add, delete, and export vectors during local demos. Production deployments should protect mutation routes with authentication and disable insecure admin access.
